goal.en: Compare people, places and choices, and talk about quantity accurately.
goal.ar: أن تقارن بين الأشخاص والأماكن والخيارات، وأن تعبّر عن الكمية بدقة.

text.en: Short adjectives add -er + than (cheaper than). Long adjectives use more + adjective + than (more expensive than).
text.ar: الصفات القصيرة تأخذ er مع than مثل cheaper than، والصفات الطويلة تأخذ more قبلها مثل more expensive than.

text.en: Never combine both: “more cheaper” is wrong. And the word after a comparison is “than”, not “from” or “that”.
text.ar: لا تجمع بين الطريقتين فتقول more cheaper. والكلمة بعد المقارنة هي than لا from ولا that، فالعربية تقول «أرخص من» فيقع الخلط.

text.en: the + adjective-est (the cheapest) or the most + adjective (the most expensive). The word “the” is required.
text.ar: نستخدم the مع est مثل the cheapest، أو the most مع الصفة الطويلة. ووجود the ضروري.

items.en: It is the biggest city in Egypt.
This is the most useful app I have.
He is the best player in the team.

text.en: Use “in” for places and groups (the tallest building in Cairo), and “of” for periods (the best day of my life).
text.ar: نستخدم in مع الأماكن والمجموعات، وof مع الفترات الزمنية.

title.en: much, many, a lot of, a few

head: Word
Use with
Example
rows: a lot of people, a lot of money

text.en: In positive statements “a lot of” is the natural choice; “much” mostly appears in questions and negatives: I don't have much time.
text.ar: في الإثبات الأطبع هو a lot of، أما much فتكثر في النفي والسؤال: I don't have much time.

text.en: Uncountable nouns have no plural: information, advice, furniture, money, news. Say “some information”, never “informations”.
text.ar: الأسماء غير المعدودة لا تُجمع: information وadvice وfurniture وmoney وnews. فنقول some information ولا نقول informations.

questions.sentence: This bag is ___ than that one.

options: My phone is better than yours for photos.
This road is more longer than that one.
Today is hotter than it was yesterday.
She is a little taller than her brother.

explanation.en: Use either -er or more, never both: longer than.
explanation.ar: نستخدم er أو more، ولا نجمع بينهما. الصواب longer than.

questions.sentence: Her English is much ___ than mine.

explanation.en: good → better (irregular). “Much” before a comparative means “a lot”.
explanation.ar: صيغة المقارنة من good هي better، وكلمة much قبلها تعني «بكثير».

prompt.en: Complete: “A car is ___ (expensive) than a bike.”
prompt.ar: أكمل: A car is ___ (expensive) than a bike.

questions.sentence: It was ___ day of my life.

explanation.ar: صيغة التفضيل العليا تحتاج the، وhappy تصير happiest.

questions.sentence: This is ___ restaurant in the city.
He is the best student ___ the class.

questions.answer: This is the most difficult question

explanation.ar: the ثم most ثم الصفة ثم الاسم.
كلمة people معدودة جمع، فنستخدم many.

questions.sentence: I don't have ___ time this week.

explanation.en: Time is uncountable → much (typical in negatives).
explanation.ar: كلمة time غير معدودة فنستخدم much، وهي شائعة في النفي.

options: He gave me some very good advice today.
I need more informations about the course.
We bought new furniture for the office.
The news about the results was surprising.

explanation.en: “Information” is uncountable and has no plural: more information.
explanation.ar: كلمة information غير معدودة ولا تُجمع، فالصواب more information.

questions.sentence: I have ___ friends in Doha — about three.

explanation.en: “A few” = a small number of countable things. “A little” is for uncountable amounts.
explanation.ar: a few للعدد القليل من المعدود، وa little للكمية القليلة من غير المعدود.

prompt.en: Match the quantifier with the noun it fits.

explanation.en: many/a few → countable; much/a little → uncountable.
explanation.ar: many وa few مع المعدود، وmuch وa little مع غير المعدود.

prompt.en: Which sentence means the two things are equal?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تعني أن الشيئين متساويان؟

options: My car is as fast as yours.
My car is faster than yours.
My car is not so fast.

explanation.en: “as + adjective + as” expresses equality; “-er than” expresses difference.
explanation.ar: تركيب as…as يدل على التساوي، بينما er than يدل على التفاضل.

options: She is the youngest in her family.
It is most beautiful beach here.
That was the worst film of the year.
He is the most careful driver I know.

explanation.en: A superlative needs “the”: the most beautiful beach.
explanation.ar: صيغة التفضيل العليا تحتاج the: the most beautiful beach.
